author: nero_eth
content:
It's a very differnt risk than being unbundled though.
The validator would be slashed for taking the bal, figuring out which txs a builder had in his block (many of which require capital on multiple exchanges), to then "steal" the strategy.
Based on avg meb payments we're talking about ~hundreds of dollars while the validator is slashed, has to exit, risks correlated penalties, etc.
For unbundling we're talking millions.
So yeah, I agree than a validator could use the info in bal but it's not trivial at all, requires a lot of capital and the "attack" is full, transparent.
I see BAL-unbundling risks as very low. The actual danger is same-slot unbundling against which builders can finally protect themselves by only releasing payloads for strong beacon blocks.

author: nero_eth
content: You can start execution with only the BAL. State prefeching is part of execution. Same for the post-state root calculation.

author: nero_eth
content: With future compatible I mean the chunk size and how we chunkify. It should be done like in BiB such that we can later adopt kzg + sampling.

author: nero_eth
content: Also, it's not "BAL having priority". It's just that having the BAL earlier is a big win in worst-case scenarios. In the happy path, both may come at the same time but what we care is only the worst-case here.

author: nero_eth
content: With glam, state prefetching and actual txs exec fights for the same cores. If we had the BAL a second earlier, we could pipeline things nicely such that a 1s earlier BAL translates to having 1s more time in the slot for the payload as state prefetching or post-state root calc are quite heavy.

author: nero_eth
content: We've seen how expensive everything around state access becomes with glam. This would be an effective lever to make state access cheaper again.

author: vladimir_ea
content: agreed any such attack / exploitation would not be trivial and it would be hard to exploit but its also not 100% risk-free - probably not a big issue, depends on how paranoid you are.
